This '''Mandalorian''' was part of the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] terrorist organization and was stationed in a [[Death Watch camp|camp]] on the snow-covered [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Carlac/Legends|Carlac]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].

==Biography==
After junior senator [[Lux Bonteri/Legends|Lux Bonteri]] arrived on the planet of Carlac along with [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] to deliver a [[Holotrace device/Legends|holotrace device]] with the location of [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] leader [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] to the Mandalorian terrorist organization known as the Death Watch, the three were lead by the Mandalorians into their campsite. Inside the camp, this soldier along with a [[Unidentified Death Watch soldier 2|fellow one]] were practicing shooting their [[GALAAR-15 blaster carbine|blaster carbines]] at two captured [[Monster droid/Legends|junk droids]].

The soldier and the rest of the Death Watch were later seen attacking the [[Ming Po/Legends|Ming Po]] [[Ming Po town|town]] under orders from [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]] and after the identity of Ahsoka Tano was revealed, the soldiers along with the Death watch members fought R2-D2s repaired [[Droid/Legends|droid]] squadron.
